claims.text: The profile, authorised and issued by the Office of the Lord Chamberlain on 28 July 2008, says that the King was proclaimed Monarch in September 2006, that his father died 'two years ago', and that his official coronation takes place on 1 August.
claims.locator: Opening paragraphs; divestment paragraph; sign-off 'Office of the Lord Chamberlain, 28 July 2008'
claims.uncertainty: Month-level corroboration of the proclamation. The coronation date is prospective and 'two years ago' is relative, so neither is given a structured date here.

claims.text: The profile states that King George, as Crown Prince, acted as Prince Regent on numerous occasions and presided over meetings of the Privy Council, especially when his father's health began to fail.
claims.locator: Paragraph on his service before accession
claims.uncertainty: Undated and general: no instrument, occasion or period is given. Regency observations, not a reign.
